description: Canonical bridge policies for Cici's runtime connections. Defines session scoping, flush rules, and sync behaviour for each bridge.

bridges.description: OB1 MCP server running as a Supabase Edge Function. Primary store for all captured thoughts.

sync_rules.note: If governed-state and Supabase runtime disagree on a fact, governed-state is canonical. Never overwrite governed-state with Supabase data without an approved proposal.

bridges.description: Telegram Bot API connection. Stateless from Telegram's perspective — all durable state is stored in Supabase via OB1 MCP.

session_policy.description: A 'session' is a continuous conversation window. Gaps > 60 minutes start a new session context.
session_policy.capture_what: Each user message + Cici reply pair, tagged #telegram and #conversation

context_injection.description: At the start of each session, inject into the LLM system prompt: voice/session-behavior.json rules, top-3 recalled preferences (#preference), top-3 relevant memories (search by message content).
sources: supabase-search: top-3 relevant to current message
